consensus.note: Independent AI interpretation of the same supplied evidence; not measured exact-score accuracy or a substitute for the baseline.

disclaimer: No independent browsing by LLMs. All provider facts were supplied in the same time-checked packet; AI-only exact scores are not validated as superior.

market_context.note: See separate source-stamped market snapshot on v9 forecasts.

verified_lineup_adjustments.reason: Unvalidated player and formation coefficients are not applied to model goal rates.

verified_xg_xga.reason: No licensed timestamped true xG feed configured; shots or scoring averages are not labelled xG.

formations.reason: Source-reported formation only; no tactical-strength coefficient.

goal_form.reason: Windows report actual counts; short samples are not padded.

goalkeeper.reason: Starting XI names do not establish goalkeeper identity, fitness, availability or shot-stopping quality.

head_to_head.reason: Descriptive context; no fitted H2H adjustment.

injuries_absences.reason: Reported absences only; no reports does not confirm a fully fit squad.

markets_1x2.reason: Dated complete bookmaker market; estimate includes quoted source timestamps.

markets_totals_btts.reason: Only actually captured timestamped totals/BTTS prices.

player_impact.reason: No independently validated player-absence or formation coefficients; no numeric adjustment applied.

rest_schedule.reason: Gap from latest known kickoff; incomplete competition history cannot prove actual team rest.

shot_xg_xga.reason: Genuine provider-reported historical Expected Goals only; not a future score or observed future-match xG.

shots.reason: Actual historical source statistics from existing fixture-statistics responses; not estimated from xG.

shots_on_target.reason: Actual historical source statistics from existing fixture-statistics responses; not estimated from xG.

starting_lineups.reason: Provider-reported XI; absence of a response does not establish the expected lineup.

suspensions.reason: Only explicitly reported suspensions; absence is unknown.

travel.reason: No verified origin, destination or trip schedule; team names cannot establish travel distance.

venue_form.reason: Home team at home; away team away. Available competition history only.

weather.reason: No venue-matched forecast observed before this evidence cutoff.

limitations: Missing features are unknown, never zero.
Source observation timestamps remain null where not archived.
Historical availability estimates are distinct from actual fetch times.
Descriptive features do not prove a prediction accuracy gain.

factors: Bologna holds a superior statistical model projection (0.56 away win probability).
Venezia exhibits low home scoring volume (0.83 goals per match).
Model expected goals favor Bologna (1.72 vs 0.94).
gemini.uncertainty: Unvalidated tactical formations, injuries, and true xG feed; relies entirely on frozen statistical model and past regulation score windows.

factors: Bologna has higher expected goals and recent form.
Venezia struggles defensively, allowing 2.1 goals per match in past 10.
Bologna scores more frequently, shown in BTTS and goals per match.
openai.uncertainty: Many missing features may impact prediction accuracy.
